DJ Willy Lopez felt knocks on the studio door and saw a luminous figure on the terrace. He then observed a yellow‑white saucer ≈40 ft in diameter hovering above the cooling tower; the terrace grew unnaturally hot and civil‑defense personnel later checked radiation levels .
1 observer (on plane departing San Juan) photographed 3, then 4, circular lights traveling near the aircraft at night. (Anonymous lights caught on multiple photos.) . 1

location_name: Over Puerto Rico (en route to Florida)

attributes.description: At ~23:40, the USS John King (DDG-3) bridge crew, including the QMOW, observed six uniform, glowing green circular formations beneath the water. The ship passed over three of them, illuminating the ocean bottom (~20 ft draft). Sea state was calm, moonless, and clear. OOD logged it as “glowing algae,” but no marine bioluminescence matched the event.

12:40 PM. Jessica Walker, husband Misael Calderón, and 5-year-old son filming video at Mayagüez Zoo in the area with wooden monkey and chicken cages. Upon reviewing footage at home, discovered a strange egg-headed creature with two black eyes, small mouth/nose, and apparent self-luminescence that was not visible during filming. Animals in the cage were disturbed, restless, and fled into shelter during filming. 5-year-old spontaneously said 'that looks like an alien.' Video pre-analyzed by Lucy Guzmán, Orlando Pla, Andrew Álvarez; dark humanoid silhouette confirmed. Full analysis pending. Source: Inexplicata Feb 2007 summary, Lucy Guzmán/Ovni.Net.
Witness saw dark crouched figure with shiny eyes attack a goat; leapt 9 ft fence. Blood & hair samples collected.
Witnesses (including police) reported a spherical object with bright yellow lights floating over the mountains near Adjuntas for ~5 minutes.
Grandparents saw a small humanoid-shaped ball of light moving through their house; wife heard voices in unknown language. Entity vanished after following husband into bathroom.
USS Wasp radar tracked a fast-moving object at 1,200 mph and 50,000 ft. A DF‑9 fighter attempted intercept but failed to close distance.
A jet aircraft, possibly an F-14, pursued a domed disc-shaped UFO. The object stopped mid-air and then split in half—one half flying southwest, the other east. The jet circled, then left the area.
Mid-day sighting, shape not logged; possibly misfiled entry.
Nino González experienced a CE-2: his television and household appliances went dark as a “flying saucer” passed overhead.

9:00 AM. Man jogging near salt flats saw several beings (~5-6, 6 ft tall, very thin, large bald heads, large slanted luminous eyes, gray-blue skin, long thin arms, sharp teeth) apparently struggling with a dark-haired man in stupor, attempting to carry him to shoreline where metallic domed oval craft hovered silently. Source: ThinkAboutItDocs.

location_name: Tallaboa (Ponce Salt Flats area), Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Giant UFO observed descending into swamp; ‘elevator’ with humanoids and robotic creature seen by Melvin Rosado.

Two local girls (Migdalia Cintrón and Aida Rivera), involved in previous encounters, again encountered a beautiful female figure that held on firmly to them and told them she needed them to come with her. Possible religious/contact phenomenon. Source: ThinkAboutItDocs.
Farmer claimed abduction by tall beings; burnt soil was documented.

9:30 AM. Witness alone in kitchen: tall blond man in light tight-fitting outfit with red light at waist appeared, communicated telepathically 'not to be afraid.' Witness blacked out, awakened in large silvery oval room with similar beings and computer terminals. Examined by blond beings and shorter large-headed grey being using brilliant blue light. Source: Robiou Lamarche, Manifiesto OVNI en Puerto Rico Santo Domingo Y Cuba.
Saucer-shaped craft chased by military jet observed by Freddie Cruz, then director of Civil Defense Agency of Lajas. Source: Alan Caviness research compilation.

Reynaldo Calzada, a U.S. Navy security supervisor for 35 years, reported witnessing a hovering disc-shaped craft with violet lights near an explosives storage area. Shortly after, a cigar-shaped object descended and absorbed the disc. Two more objects then emerged from the larger craft, circled around it, and disappeared. Jorge Martín believes this may have been part of a secret U.S. Navy program to monitor or initiate contact with non-human entities.

Witnesses and local officials reported a UFO “crash” near Laguna Cartagena. Officials claimed Coast Guard and mayor’s office involvement; multiple flames/fire reported. Footage and witness reports coordinated in UFO Casebook.

Afternoon. Man walking on wooded hillside saw large silvery cylinder/'elevator' emerge from ground. Four tall blond men in tight blue uniforms emerged, followed by a taller hulking dark-haired figure. Blond men searched area while hairy being followed obediently. Source: ThinkAboutItDocs.
Venezuelan Super-Constellation at 10,000 ft encountered a glowing object that paralleled aircraft for minutes before accelerating away. CIA document source: cia-rdp81r00560r000100010001-0.

During a U.S. Navy anti-submarine warfare exercise off Puerto Rico, multiple ships and aircraft detected an underwater object moving far faster than any known sub—over 150 knots . Sonar contacts showed the unknown submersible maneuvering around the fleet and diving to an impossible depth of 27,000 feet . The task force tracked this super-fast “USO” for four days before the contact finally broke off .

12:30 PM. Two C-130 Hercules aircraft (one black, one olive/camouflage) flew extremely low over Yauco at Yauco Plaza, barely clearing TV and cell towers on Hwy 2 hill, banking steeply until wings nearly touched the hillside. Residents phoned San Juan to report. Described as weekly routine. Coincided with island-wide Federal operations. Source: Inexplicata/OVNI.Net Feb 2006 summary, Lucy Guzmán.

During US Navy 'Springboard' exercises: one submarine broke away to pursue an unknown object moving at 150 knots (maximum submersible speed of the era was 45 knots). Fleet uncertain if it was a decoy or real anomaly. Object spent 4 days in the area, plunging to depths of 27,000 feet; 13 captains entered the incident in their ships' logs. USO communicated single-screw propulsion to COMLANT technicians. Object vanished after 96 hours. Source: Ivan Sanderson, Invisible Residents (1970); Inexplicata/Scott Corrales March 2012.

location_name: Waters off Puerto Rico (Springboard Exercises area)

attributes.description: Night. 18-year-old alone at home: two tall thin beings with large heads and eyes appeared, paralyzed him, and carried him aboard large oval craft with flange. Taken to undersea city/installation, medically examined and cured of ulcers and hemorrhoids, then transported back home. Animals subsequently react violently in his presence. Source: Jorge Martín, Enigma #1.

Early evening. Uncommonly large luminous object descended on El Gigante hill near copper mine test pits. Police officers present who told radio personality Edwin Plaza: object had lights underneath projecting a single white ray lighting up the hill, made no sound despite its massive size. Object's beam was apparently directed at an agricultural school on El Gigante slopes that focused on 'improved cattle ranching techniques.' Journalist Julio Víctor Ramírez covered the story for El Vocero. Source: Inexplicata/Scott Corrales 2015.

location_name: El Gigante hill, Adjuntas (copper mine test pit sector), Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Multiple disc-shaped craft in formation with rotating rim lights; sped off in unison.
Farmer’s security camera captured a “metallic humanoid” inspecting crops at 3 AM.
Mr. Buenaventura Quiñones and his wife saw a glowing disk at ~7–8 PM so low they heard a buzzing motor sound; neighbors had seen it on previous nights too.

At 21:15 GMT, 40 officers and sailors from Command Task Group 45.2 observed a bluish-silver circular object over the sea. The object appeared larger than the moon, hovered for 10 seconds, then departed southwest. Total duration: 30 seconds. Logged in Project Blue Book files.
Witnesses reported a humanoid figure near a landed disc.

Orlando Franceschi, ambulance driver, confronted a 5-ft tall humanoid with long ears, long nose, lipless mouth, grey skin, “black spot” eyes, ape-like jawline. Attacked it with a shovel twice with no effect. On third swing, he became numb and paralyzed. Entity then faded into thin air.

Four Puerto Rico National Guard members (off-duty) and three children encountered small Grey alien (~3-4 ft) while shrimp fishing in El Yunque at ~9 p.m. Being made wavy-gait walk, had egg-like head, dark eyes, skinny body, membrane connecting torso to upper arms. Flying saucer descended from El Yunque mountain, landed; 2 more Greys emerged and flanked the first. All witnesses paralyzed. Beings spoke in Spanish with strange accent before re-entering craft, which departed toward antenna sector at El Yunque summit. Source: senior PRNG officer confidential statement to Jorge Martín.

location_name: Las Tres T area, El Yunque, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Multiple witnesses observed a strange object with unusual shape over the water.
Elderly farming couple reported repeated falls of coins and stones from nowhere (since 2004). Phenomena occurred at home and in fields; coins preserved.

A police officer saw a glowing light descending into the El Yunque rainforest; immediately his patrol car’s engine and lights went out. Authorities found no debris. Later the Forest Service suggested it may have been a meteor .

A resident walking their dog near Villa Marina saw a formation of lights resembling a metallic object flying low. The object was completely silent. Witness believes others in the neighborhood also saw the object. Reported to Lucy Guzman the next day. No images or video were taken.
Video captured of silvery, rhomboidal object in the sky; reported on Univision’s Primer Impacto.
Hotel guests and staff at Caribe Hilton Hotel (Tutela & Rodriguez) observed two saucer‑shaped objects over the ocean at 19:45 heading NNE.

US Navy Armed Guard aboard the freighter SS Cornelia reported an unidentified submerged object (USO) in the water near San Juan. The watchstander noted the object left a wake and was unable to identify it. He notified his superiors, a destroyer was dispatched, and by the next morning the destroyer had engaged and sunk a German U‑boat at that location .
A sighting classified as “Other” type lasted between 7–10 minutes. Specific object type or features not detailed.

José Martínez Echevarría stepped onto a terrace after rainfall and saw an enormous triangular object appear silently with a strong light. It crossed the sky slowly at low altitude before vanishing into clouds while he was on the phone with Willie Durand.

Traveling salesman Edwin Almenas encountered a pillar of flame/fireball on the roadside that killed his car’s electrical systems. The object emitted golden-orange beams. Terrified, he watched it rise and vanish; afterward the car restarted. The next evening, on his return to San Juan, he again experienced voices in his head, another car shutdown, and saw a fireball. A 3-ft-tall humanoid figure enveloped in light appeared, holding “two rings” and a flashlight-like device. It pointed toward El Torito mountain, merged back into the fireball, and departed. Almenas later reported neck and head pain.
1 witness saw a bright orange orb (near Jupiter) that split into 3 orbs (1 orange, 2 blue); all moved silently at ~3000 km/h across the sky . 1

5:30 a.m. Victor Delgado driving to work in Carolina observed huge flying saucer hovering over slope near top of El Yunque mountain. Three tiers, many colored lights on underside circling, large yellow-green dome on top. Estimated 1,500 ft diameter. Same 'carrousel' type craft regularly observed by El Yunque area residents. Source: Jorge Martín.

location_name: Cubuy sector, near El Yunque, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Dozens of animals blood-loss claim; winged creature seen. Described as “La Gárgola.”

7:40 PM. Researchers José A. Martínez, Luiseppi Quiñones, and Wanda I. Vélez near Laguna Cartagena: bright flashing object observed emitting powerful flashes reflected on passing cars, then dimmed when camcorder turned on. When camcorder turned off, object lit up again and flew toward Salinas de Cabo Rojo at extreme speed leaving incandescent wake, causing nearby dogs to howl (inaudible sound). 45 minutes later: second object observed headed toward Salinas de Cabo Rojo from the sea direction, rising and captured on video. Object flew from Cabo Rojo to Lajas to Monte del Estado (Maricao State Forest) where TV/radio/police repeaters are located. Source: Inexplicata Jan 2011/José Martínez.

location_name: La Parguera / Laguna Cartagena area, Lajas, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: 9:15 AM. Young secretary heard strange sound and found two small men (~3 ft tall) studying a map of Puerto Rico hanging on wall. Beings had long arms, short legs, large flat-backed heads, large ears, two small antennae, wore shiny transparent green outfits. Second witness saw beings exit through window. Source: Robiou Lamarche, Manifiesto OVNI en Puerto Rico Santo Domingo Y Cuba.
Witness saw a low-flying C-130 circling repeatedly near former Ramey AFB; remarked on “strange things” in the area.

Jessica Walker, her husband Misael Calderón, and their 5-year-old son recorded a home video at the zoo which later revealed a glowing humanoid figure with an egg-shaped head, black eyes, and small facial features. The figure was not seen during filming. Animals near the location were visibly disturbed. The boy identified the figure as an “alien.” Video shown to Lucy Guzman; analysis pending.
Residents and police reported submerged lights and humanoids. Mayor supported “Extraterrestrial Route.”
Puppy found mutilated (precise injuries and a blood-loss claim). Vet necropsy confirmed non-predatory cause.
Civilian drone operator’s thermal footage caught an orb splitting into two just above the shoreline; footage was taken down after a DMCA claim by an unnamed defense contractor.
Farmer Félix Badillo found piglet dead with a precise surgical incision on its ear; vet Ángel de la Sierra said wound looked “experimental.”
Report of a pixelated humanoid form and metallic spheres in the Salinas/Yayales area. Exact date unresolved.

Marines at Roosevelt Roads observed one or more disc-shaped craft overhead. A-7 fighter jets were scrambled to intercept and reportedly photographed one “disc.” The military gave no official explanation .

During early morning guard duty, a very bright light appeared above the gatehouse, causing power and phone failure. The object vanished as quickly as it appeared, after which power and communication resumed. Reported internally. Logged in NUFORC (Oct 4, 2003) submission.
Residents reported intense subterranean buzzing and drilling noises over several nights. Public protests occurred before all coverage was abruptly dropped.

Frontier Airlines Flight 4139 (A20N) at FL350 reported 2–5 lights moving up/down and left/right above the horizon. Pilot unable to determine distance or altitude. No evasive action; no ATC impact. Logged by Washington Operations Center.
A Venezuelan Super-Constellation at 10,000 ft encountered a glowing object that paralleled it for minutes before accelerating away.

UFO flap returns to central mountains, following renewed Cabo Rojo activity in late 1980s. Residents of Adjuntas and Utuado reporting unusual craft settling on surrounding mountains. Large spherical object observed disgorging smaller objects, all vanishing westward. Area highlighted for: copper mine test pits (Kennecott), speculated non-human interest in mineral deposits. Watchman Heriberto Acosta at Lajas municipal dump saw turtle-shell-shaped object whitish-lit underneath hovering ~60 ft above him, no lights but cast illumination like daylight, then suddenly ascended. Skywatch recordings (audio) by Willie Durand Urbina/PRRG document triangular objects departing Utuado toward Pellejas/Juan González/Jayuya, aircraft reconnoitering objects. Source: Inexplicata/Scott Corrales 2015.

location_name: Adjuntas and Utuado, Puerto Rico (Barrio Pellejas, Barrio Guilarte)

attributes.description: Witnesses saw a cone-shaped luminous object joined by another. One made a sharp “L” turn toward San Juan.

Two Puerto Rican men, Jose Maldonado Torres and Jose Pagan Santos, disappeared while flying Ercoupe N3808H from Santo Domingo to San Juan. At ~8:03 p.m., they issued a Mayday reporting a “weird object” altering their course multiple times and causing navigational failure. An Iberia flight relayed their transmissions. Radar contact was lost ~35 miles west of Puerto Rico. No wreckage was ever found.
U.S. Navy personnel observed maneuvering, hovering objects near naval exercises off Puerto Rico’s coast.

location_name: Atlantic Fleet Weapons Training Facility, Vieques

attributes.description: Continued radar detection of the unknown aerial target by USS Gyatt. Object showed advanced maneuverability and erratic speeds.

Angel Encarnación and fishermen: observed huge disc-shaped flying saucer hovering ~100 ft over ocean off Vieques south coast. Object had yellow/green/red rotating lights around edge and single large green light on bottom. Object was absorbing seawater in visible upward column through underside. After several minutes departed at high speed toward El Yunque. Second incident: huge round green light rose from seafloor, surfaced silently, rose into sky with sound of water falling. Source: Jorge Martín/IRAAP UFOs and Aliens in the Caribbean (2000).

location_name: South of Navy firing range, Vieques, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: [Other] Laguna Carta
A bright circular light hovered for several minutes before vanishing.

In broad daylight, a metallic disc silently hovered above a schoolyard before shooting upward and disappearing. Witnesses included schoolchildren and a teacher, whose accounts were consistent. The incident was reported in local media, increasing its credibility.

Locals reported a “gargoyle-like” creature preying on animals and possibly humans. Victims’ skeletons allegedly found in half-flooded tunnels of abandoned sugar mill. Described as large, winged, sulfur-smelling, feeding on animals by exsanguination. Officer Miguel Negrón heard loud wing-flapping while patrolling.
William Serrano reported seeing a light approach as he walked home. Lights in his house browned-out as the object neared. When it headed directly toward him, he dove into brushwood to avoid it.
Multiple witnesses saw UFOs at 1,500–3,000 ft: a white cylinder, a silver rectangle that dissolved, and a grid of lights.
Civilian witnesses reported a daylight unidentified aerial object over San Juan in the early 1960s.

Logan Paul reports witnessing a bright, fast-moving luminous object crossing the sky over the marina area. The video shows a concentrated white light traveling horizontally at high speed with no visible navigation lights or audible sound, exiting the frame in under a second. Multiple voices react with confusion. No official explanation is given.

Luis Ortiz (resort employee) observed large oval object with bright yellow-orange light followed by 4 smaller objects (white/yellow/red/blue) flying east toward Camp García at ~9:00 PM. No engine or propeller sound. Objects stopped in midair. On one occasion two such objects passed toward east, then military jets followed, then explosions; only one object returned. Wife Mercedes Sanés observed from La Mina balcony: large golden-yellow light hovering 30+ minutes near Camp García before departing. Source: Jorge Martín, Vieques: Polígono del 3er. Tipo.

location_name: Sun Bay / La Mina area, Vieques, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Official Project Blue Book entry describing UFO sighting near Ramey Air Force Base. Disc-like aerial object.
A cylindrical shape over the Río Piedras area. Jorge Martín said: "There are reports of having been seen, in other parts of Puerto Rico."
El Mundo reporter Miguel Angel Santin and colleague saw a luminous object with a greenish cast, flying east to west at low azimuth.
Civilian letter to DoD describing platinum star-shaped object with trailing red glow; rose into high altitude until lost from view. Blue Book Case File 8701081

José (26) and Jeami Martínez (21) discovered 30 chickens slaughtered in cages overnight. Animals had deep puncture marks and were blood-loss claim. Reporters found carcasses, broken cages, and animal prints. Police referred case to Civil Defense. Chief José Belardo dismissed it but admitted a U.S. Marines radar image had shown a strange creature. Couple suspected the Chupacabras.
Hundreds of witnesses observed a disc with bright lights flying very low over Levittown. Police Sgt. Cordero photographed it on Polaroid as it passed directly overhead.

Captain, OOD, CICWO, and bridge crew aboard the USS Steinaker (DD-863) observed a large aerial object (~300 ft wide), glowing with what resembled roiling lightning. The ship passed beneath it at ~100 ft below cloud level. Not detected on radar. Described as brighter than daylight. Initially suspected to be “ball lightning,” but no atmospheric or electrical explanation fit. Reported to MUFON.

Elderly farming couple repeatedly pelted by coins and river stones by an invisible presence since 2004 (continuing through Feb 2006). Occurs mostly in morning when woman makes coffee, outdoors in fields, and in two different homes. Pattern suggests the phenomenon follows the new husband (remarried 2004 after 2003 widowing). Investigation by Andrew Álvarez and Lucy Guzmán pending. Source: Inexplicata/OVNI.Net Feb 2006 summary, Lucy Guzmán.

IR sensor on a US Customs/Border aircraft recorded two UAPs splitting and skimming over the ocean. AARO later assessed the objects moved at wind speed and had no anomalous motion. A second, still-unreleased FLIR video from the same mission was confirmed by CBP but has not yet been publicly shared.

Early evening. Photographer Frank McFerran and wife driving near Mayagüez observed brilliant light changing colors and casting reflections on sea surface. They parked at Punta Guanajibo to observe the object near the Cabo Rojo lighthouse. After 20 minutes of color changes, the object vanished; witnesses speculated it plunged into the ocean. Source: Inexplicata/Scott Corrales, Caribbean Crisis (2010).

location_name: Punta Guanajibo area, near Cabo Rojo lighthouse, Mayagüez, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Driver encountered humanoid with glowing red eyes near cemetery.
Object at 3,500 mph returned encrypted Mode 3 IFF—tracked near PR radar zone.
Pedro Navarro saw shining metallic oval (like two superimposed plates) flying under clouds ~3000 ft. Static 15 sec then zigzagged into cloud.
Subsea probe detected a pulse at 6 100 m causing an echo scatter pattern unlike geological events.

Multiple residents reported large UFOs similar to the Jan 14 Mount Briton craft flying into or emerging from El Yunque rain forest, over section of permanently closed road 191. Sightings lasted 30 minutes to 1 hour, day and night. US soldiers in black uniforms or camouflage without IDs confronted residents at gunpoint when they approached. Road 191 is not a military restricted zone. Source: Jorge Martín investigation.

location_name: Río Blanco and Florida communities, Naguabo (near El Yunque), Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Corrections officer I. Simonetti observed a brass-colored object swinging in pendulum motion before taking off north. Crowds in the street pointed at it; a neighbor photographed it. Photos showed an object similar to the McMinnville UFO, with rooftops, palm trees, and streetlights giving altitude reference.

During a 24-hour time-lapse commercial shoot from the rooftop of the Sheraton Hotel in San Juan, a luminous object was captured accelerating eastward toward El Yunque. The phenomenon was only noticed during playback. The footage—long presumed lost or inaccessible—has resurfaced in part on YouTube.
Oval luminous craft hovered over base perimeter, then accelerated west over the ocean.

In fall 1952, three Pan American Airways pilots (Captains Zammett, Harris, Hutchins) on a flight from New York toward San Juan observed a large metallic UFO. The object hovered nearby for several minutes, then accelerated away at high speed .
Locals reported hovering craft emitting a low hum. Humanoids briefly visible near the craft. Possible geothermal/boron connection. Multiple corroborations.
Naval cadet observed a silver “needle” zipping silently across the southern sky during a daylight exercise.

Large red ball of fire flew and made turns over lagoon, descended slowly and controlled into the lagoon waters with buzzing sound. At 2:00 AM: huge flying saucer hovering low over lagoon covered with bright white light, circling slowly ~2 min before departing at high speed. Next day at 1:55 PM: the Laguna Cartagena tremor/explosion (originally reported epicenter 81,000 ft deep under lagoon). Source: Jorge Martín/IRAAP.

location_name: Maguayo community, near Laguna Cartagena, Lajas, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Afternoon. Inocencio Cataquet, expert skin-diver from northwestern Puerto Rico, fishing when he observed a huge object moving underwater, estimated ~200 ft in diameter. He plunged in and touched it — not metallic, but porous and filled with small holes. Water around the object began heating up; object then moved away at high speed underwater and broke the surface, ascending skyward as 'a tiny little point of light.' Source: Inexplicata/Scott Corrales, Ships and Saucers (2012).

location_name: Northwestern Puerto Rico coastal waters (near Aguadilla)

attributes.description: Radar at Ramey AFB tracked two large disk-shaped UFOs. Navy A-4D jets were scrambled; the UFOs made impossible maneuvers before vanishing over the ocean.

Two Puerto Rico Air National Guard pilots chased a triangular UFO over San Juan. They “followed a ‘triangular shaped object, 50 feet in diameter’ for 20 minutes” before running low on fuel. The object was silent and large, witnesses reported.
Navy divers encountered a USO that disabled their equipment.

Multiple residents reported seeing a flying object as part of a surge in UFO activity in the area. Photos were allegedly taken but later deleted from the internet. Ufologist Reinaldo Rios and the local mayor investigated the sightings, adding a layer of official interest.
A Caribair and Pan Am jet reported a UFO over Isla Verde. FAA later confirmed the event; a 1977 report acknowledged pilot sightings.
Photographer “ADC” captured a UFO in one frame while testing his camera; next photo taken seconds later showed only clouds. Photos analyzed by Alexander Rivera; object absent in control shot.
Unknown entity killed goat, samples recovered (blood & hair).
8:30 PM. Mr. Berríos (pseudonym) and one companion: brilliant red circular/star-like object at very high altitude moving horizontally. Source: Inexplicata Feb 2007 summary, Lucy Guzmán/Ovni.Net.

location_name: Barrio Sabana Hoyos, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: USS Gyatt tracked an unidentified object on radar approaching from the northeast. An F‑8 Crusader was launched from Roosevelt Roads for interception. The object reportedly outpaced the fighter and ascended rapidly beyond its altitude ceiling. Radar screen photos were allegedly reviewed by the Foreign Technology Division (FTD).
Cigar-shaped object stationary in sky, reflecting sunlight; then moved away.

After a UFO allegedly crashed into a slope of El Yunque, witnesses reported U.S. military retrieval of the craft and bodies. A High-ranking U.S. officer: 15 soldiers & 3 officers encountered unknown presence; equipment failure; footsteps and firing; trail of green luminescent “blood” after entity shot. Specialized units from Roosevelt Roads arrived. Records altered.

location_name: La Coca Waterfall, Sierra de Luquillo

attributes.description: Fireball reappeared over the location. Seen again by the same witness and several neighbors. One neighbor captured it on a cellphone. A twin-engine plane flew overhead ~15 minutes after the object vanished.

Farmer Luis Torres, son José Daniel, and neighbors saw silver-colored craft as large as a house crossing sky at treetop level ~100 yards away. Lights resembled police squad car lights. CEOVNI investigation linked to Moca Vampire animal mutilation wave.
Luminous disc ~40 ft diameter with row of dark windows positioned itself over antennae of Radio Procer radio station. Jorge Martín documented as part of 1994-1997 Chupacabras/UFO wave.

Splitting of a pilot balloon image into two or more portions, initially attributed to double refraction at a high atmospheric layer. Report suggests balloon may have actually burst into two hemispheres, each maintaining its shape before breaking into smaller solid pieces.

Police (Agents Waleska Santiago & Ana Morales) and investigators documented a series of animal mutilations. At José Oscar Meléndez’s property, 3 piglets (40 days old) were found mutilated: one severely injured, one severely injured with surgically clean cuts, puncture wounds, blood-loss claim/no visible bleeding. Flesh resembled supermarket-processed meat; internal organs intact. Locals compared wounds to “Wolverine claws.” Earlier, a mare “Lucero” (owned by Osmin Ramos) and hens had also been killed. Witnesses in Vista Hermosa reported a creature resembling an ape fighting with a cat, then floating away carrying it. Residents also reported cows, goats, and dogs attacked. Cement casts were attempted of prints near the scene.
Following an explosion, witnesses saw a glowing object crash into the hills. Primer Impacto aired footage; some claimed the military retrieved wreckage.
Civilian and author of this spreadsheet captured telescope footage of what looks like a star but it is maneuvering erraticallyat extreme speeds.
Chupacabras attack killed 18 hens, 4 geese, 10 roosters. Police filed report; carcasses sent for analysis.

Around 8:00 PM, numerous residents (adults, children, elderly) saw a domed UFO move east to west at low altitude. It hovered near a forested plateau. Later, children witnessed it emit a bright beam, releasing five glowing green spheres. A blue light shone through a square opening on its side. The object released a white smoke-like substance and hovered over a nearby structure before departing. Witnesses described a low humming sound and said the object behaved as if it were “observing.”

Nancy Alvarado reported that while waiting in her car she heard a voice in her head saying “don’t be afraid.” She then saw two human-like figures—one in white, one in dark green—gliding just above the ground. Both had black hair, small shiny eyes, and tight one-piece suits. After gazing at her, they crossed the street toward a wooded field and vanished.

Residents witnessed red ball coming out of sky and breaking the waters of Laguna Cartagena. Event described as "controlled." Hours later at 2 a.m. May 31, a large cylinder-shaped object seen. Large fissures appeared in ground around Lajas and Cabo Rojo emitting cobalt-colored smoke. Military personnel in anti-contamination suits collected samples. Laguna Cartagena cordoned off. Investigated by Jorge Martin beginning summer 1987. Source: UFO Insight/Jorge Martin.
Multiple drivers on the Mayagüez–Hormigueros road saw a pulsating light darting across the sky. Some described it as an orb. Vehicle radios experienced interference.

Fishermen reported encountering a USO and a humanoid figure at sea. A video of the incident was shared on social media by @528vibes. Multiple crew members corroborated the story, lending strong credibility.

An airport employee (pseudonym “Mr. Rodriguez”) reported repeated sightings of bright, round or triangular white and red lights near the new control tower. One of the most intense sightings occurred at 8:20–8:30 p.m., when he boarded an American Eagle flight and witnessed a massive triangular UFO near Route 3. The object performed a U-turn and flew toward Fajardo and Vieques. Other witnesses confirmed seeing the object. Pilots refused to comment. Researcher Ana Ríos also saw similar lights from Isla Verde.

location_name: Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport, Carolina

attributes.description: Francisco Soto Borges observed fleet of seven disc-shaped craft in perfect formation flying soundlessly over the coastal community. He would experience a repeat event in May 1972. Source: Inexplicata/Scott Corrales, UFOs over Latin America and Spain.
~2000 witnesses saw two large glowing yellow-orange orbs drift over the city, settle ~1 mile offshore in the Atlantic, repeatedly enter/exist the water (USO/UFO).

Quintín Ramírez (brother of Zulma Ramírez) encounters two tall blond beings (~6-7 ft) in tight silver suits emerging from Laguna Cartagena at Las Guanábanas dirt lane. Beings smiled and returned to lagoon when he asked them not to approach. Subsequent undisclosed additional encounters. Witness died before reporting publicly. Source: Jorge Martín/IRAAP.
Widespread livestock mutilations; ~1,000 animals reportedly blood-loss claim. Witnesses described a 4–6 ft tall creature with large oval eyes.

Residents reported what appeared to be a submerged UFO during a city crisis. Videos and photos were allegedly shared by witnesses on social media, including @WorldNews_X_, but not all media remains accessible.

Corrections officer I. Simonetti walking home observed a brass-colored object swinging in pendular motion in the sky, initially thought to be a kite, before it took off northward. People on the street shouting and pointing at sky. A neighbor on a rooftop photographed the object. Simonetti obtained copies and forwarded them to CEOVNI: photographs depict a black, turreted object. Rooftops, palm trees, and streetlights visible in photo allow altitude determination. Source: Inexplicata/Scott Corrales 2023.

location_name: Barrio Obrero, San Juan, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Night. José Corrales photographed a huge silent triangular UFO at near-midnight from residential area. MUFON case. Source: ThinkAboutItDocs/MUFON CMS.

location_name: Urb. Los Angeles, Carolina, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Brilliant red circular object like a star at very high altitude moving horizontally. 2 witnesses. Reported to OVNI.net.

location_name: Barrio Sabana Hoyos, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Americo Paoli and three others saw four luminous discs flying in pairs. Described as shiny with a straw-like color; observed from outside a pharmacy.

Security officer José Vélez observed large luminous spheres with bluish-white light (like electric arc welding) approaching Observatory and hovering, increasing and decreasing in apparent size (interpreted as approach/withdrawal). Seen multiple times, assessed as intelligently controlled. Additionally: (1) Police witnessed large luminous cylinder hovering over Observatory; (2) Residents observed landings of silvery saucer-craft with humanoid crews in silver suits; (3) Saucer-craft observed on ground, then took off after human personnel departed in white van from Road #10 near Observatory; (4) US military Hummers pursued ovoid objects flying into Río Abajo forest. Source: Jorge Martín IRAAP (2005).
Students & professors saw metallic disc hovering above campus. Photos allegedly taken but unreleased. Multi-witness academic sighting.

6:27 PM. Dark object flying over Ponce making erratic axis rotations with slow forward movement at ~1000 ft altitude; moved W to E at 15-30 MPH, then made 100-degree left turn toward Playa de Ponce. Witness (aviation enthusiast) excluded all known aircraft types. Wife saw silver detail to object. Source: Inexplicata/OVNI.Net Jan 2006 summary, Lucy Guzmán.
Civilian witnesses reported an unidentified aerial object over the interior mountainous region during the early post-2000 period, with no coastal association mentioned.
Witnesses reported a disc-shaped object, visible for approximately 40 minutes before vanishing.

Connection noted between UFO activity and copper mine test pits near Adjuntas (Kennecott Copper operations). UFO sightings drawn to mining operations. Specifically mentioned in context of PR/Adjuntas skywatch recordings 1990-91. Source: Inexplicata/Scott Corrales, Neglected Lights: Mexico's 1970s Saucer Wave (Jan 2012).

location_name: Adjuntas, Puerto Rico (copper mine test pits)

attributes.description: Veteran fisherman Alicio Ayala observed a large, glowing object pacing his boat before descending silently into the sea near a deep trench.

7:00 PM. Lucy Guzmán and Orlando Pla in Lions Club parking lot: observed very intense white light twice the apparent size of Saturn, under cloud layer at ~1500-2000 ft, moving E to W. Light dimmed then intensified again. No navigation lights, vanished — ruled out ISS, airplane, satellite. Not captured on video attempt. Source: Inexplicata Feb 2007 summary, Lucy Guzmán/Ovni.Net.

location_name: Mayagüez Lions Club, Mayagüez, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Witnesses reported a dark object moving erratically over the city. Initially mistaken for a balloon; observed for ~3 minutes before vanishing.

~9:00 PM. Francisco Soto Borges on his porch observed a large light illuminate surroundings like helicopter searchlight. Circular craft partially concealed by cloud, only a few hundred feet up, with blue/red/golden lights streaming down to porch. A second vehicle appeared next to the first. Neighbors summoned to witness the display. Both craft disappeared without appearing to move from their positions. Source: Inexplicata/Scott Corrales, UFOs over Latin America and Spain.
Francisco Soto Borges saw fleet of 7 disc-shaped craft in perfect formation flying soundlessly over Aguadilla coastal community.
Unspecified anomalous aerial phenomenon observed.
Eight goats and twelve rabbits mutilated. Watchmen heard a deafening noise, then saw a shadowy figure running through trees.

Large cylinder-shaped object with spheres at each end observed by many residents in Betances community. Craft hovered silently for ~15 minutes before speeding away to the south. Came within 24 hours of Laguna Cartagena event. Source: UFO Insight.

Pan American Airways pilot (Capt. Van Winkle, Flight 215-A) took violent evasive action as fiery round greenish-white object appeared on collision course at 3:33 AM. Several passengers thrown from seats. Object seen over wide area of eastern Caribbean.

11:10 AM. Pedro Navarro driving past Mayagüez Zoo: observed shining metallic oval object (like two superimposed plates, self-glowing silver material, no separate lights) flying under clouds at ~3000 ft altitude, static for 15 seconds, then zigzagged and hid in cloud. SW to SE trajectory. Apparent size of birthday balloon. Navarro's first UFO sighting. Note: seen ~90 min before the zoo entity videotaping incident. Source: Inexplicata Feb 2007 summary, Lucy Guzmán/Ovni.Net.

Circular holes (~30 inches) were found in vegetation along roadsides in Juana Díaz and Guánica. Investigators (agrónomo, físico, and A. Álvarez) reported unusually high radiation and magnetism at the sites .

Francisco Soto Borges saw a large circular UFO partially hidden by a cloud. It emitted blue, red, and golden lights that bathed his porch in brilliance. A second vehicle appeared alongside it. Neighbors also witnessed the event. Borges believed the craft came from another dimension, as they vanished without moving.

A photograph taken facing the eastern cliffs of Caja de Muertos shows a small, dark, disc-shaped object in the sky (upper right). The photographer did not notice the object at the time; it became apparent only after reviewing the image later. Weather was clear and bright, and no conventional aircraft were visible in the area.
Farmer reported a silver spherical object hovering ~15 ft above his field; it emitted a low oscillating hum. Livestock refused to approach the area for hours afterward.

Witnesses reported triangular objects flashing lights and flying near airplanes. An audio recording described: “A triangular object is above [an airplane], flashing its lights. The plane is trying to find it.”
Two U.S. Army airmen observed a perfectly circular craft hovering silently, then suddenly accelerated away at tremendous speed.

Luisseppi Quinones saw the same triangular object as in the October 31 case, this time slightly later in the evening. His son attempted to photograph it, but the camera failed to capture the image. It flew silently and followed the same route.
Two hikers saw a shiny disc following them for about a mile. The object made no noise and vanished behind a hill. Police confirmed the witnesses were visibly shaken.
Very bright white light under clouds ~1500-2000 ft, twice apparent size of Saturn. No navigation lights. Observed by 3 witnesses.

3:25 AM. Reports of UFO crash near town of Lajas. A bright object was witnessed by many people followed by a large crashing noise. Site of crash investigation near Laguna Cartagena area. Event took place near where Reinaldo Rios conducted monthly UFO observation camps. Source: UFO Casebook files.
Wildlife photographer captured three frames of a luminous teardrop-shaped object rising from the lagoon; camera malfunctioned after the third shot and local dogs howled prior to the sighting.

Strong underground explosion felt and heard in Lajas-Cabo Rojo area. Described by radio broadcaster Raymond Stewart (Super B Radio, Lajas) as 'Incredible.' Part of series of explosion events tied to Laguna Cartagena UFO activity beginning May 31, 1987.
UPR research glider recorded a magnetic field fluctuation at ~ 850 m depth during a passive scan; simultaneously, a UFO was reported streaking overhead.
University students camping inland reported a black, triangular craft with dim orange lights gliding silently overhead; their GPS and compass apps glitched for about 10 minutes afterward.
Rita Rivera and sister observed and videotaped white light with horizontal motion that suddenly shut off. Ruled out satellite.

Night fishing. José 'Chino' Zaya and friend discovered series of caves near Cerro Las Tetas. Small beings (~several) were occupying one of the caves. One creature grabbed Zaya by the leg; he killed it with a stick and preserved the body in formaldehyde. Police officer Osvaldo Santiago examined and photographed the body. Prof. Calixto Peres (UPR chemistry) examined it and stated: 'In my opinion it is something extraterrestrial.' Body later examined by University of Puerto Rico. Case investigated for 2 years by Jorge Martín.

location_name: Cerro Las Tetas (Tetas de Cayey), Salinas, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: U.S. Navy Atlantic Fleet Weapons Range tracked an unknown object on a NNE course (30°) from 19°07′N, 65°05′W to 19°52′N, 64°45′W. The object emitted encrypted IFF Mode 1 transponder signals. A DF‑8 fighter flying at Mach 0.99 (650 mph) at 45,000 ft attempted to intercept but was unable to follow as the object accelerated and ascended out of range.
Fisherman‑diver reports encountering a glowing, saucer‑shaped craft underwater. Allegedly saw it move, glow, then disappear with no plausible explanation offered.
Radar tracked an object traveling slowly, then increasing speed. Object passed over the USS Bainbridge at 180 knots. Intercept attempted, but object faded.
Bright object filmed entering and exiting the Caribbean Sea near Aguadilla; broadcast on Telemundo and analyzed as a possible USO.

9:00 PM. 17 witnesses (beachgoers and fishermen) at El Tamarindo beach near Copamarina Hotel: multicolored spinning-top-shaped object emerged suddenly. A smaller light emerged from the object and fell into the sea. Witnesses Maritza Martínez and husband Geraldo Cuevas contacted ARGUS-PR researcher José Martínez. Another anonymous fisherman stated this was not his first sighting of similar lights in the Guánica beach area. Source: Inexplicata August 2007/ARGUS-PR.

location_name: El Tamarindo Beach, Guánica, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Jorge R. Rodríguez Vázquez reported a house-sized glowing object in the Salinas area during the 1988–1991 window. Exact date unresolved.

A U.S. Navy CH-53 Sea Stallion crew on a mission to recover a BQM drone witnessed a large, dark mass underwater that pulled the drone down. The diver was lifted out safely, and the object descended back into the depths. Report relayed by Commander David Fravor (2019 interview).

While driving a 1963 Impala on the Sabana Grande–Maricao road, witnesses encountered a brilliant aerial light that caused a complete vehicle shutdown. Headlights dimmed, the engine stalled, and after a blinding flash directly overhead, the car’s battery and wiring were found melted and destroyed.

The same household as the November 10, 2005 case reported renewed activity: a low-frequency hum followed by the family dog collapsing under an unknown influence and later vanishing despite being secured behind a fenced enclosure. The same witness, María Rivera, described luminous movements over the rainforest and a sense of telepathic presence similar to the 2005 incidents.

Merchant Jaime Báez and schoolteacher Aida Reyes among witnesses: a flying saucer described as 'considerable size and unexpected brightness' hovered over a sugar refinery. Reyes had to close her eyes due to brilliance comparable to the sun. Object oval-shaped and moving silently. Part of early 1950s Puerto Rico saucer wave. Source: Inexplicata/Scott Corrales, Caribbean Crisis (2010); Adjuntas article (2015).

Pyramid-shaped object seen for several days over Puerto Rico, photographed, detected on radar, and observed from National Guard and other aircraft. Inquiry by Weather Bureau for Dr. James McDonald found no agency that had released such a balloon. Case referenced in Weinstein pilot-UFO catalogue. Source: UFO-Forschung/Weinstein catalogue analysis.
Large blue light observed by Israel Acosta Meléndez and friends, hovered then accelerated away.

~9 p.m. Milton Kleber and nephew driving toward Dos Bocas lake saw oval "oyster-shaped" object flying parallel to their car at ~1000 ft elevation. Pale orange, matte, noiseless. When they stopped, object also halted and changed color from pale orange to bluish-green (mercury lamp color). Object responded to headlight flashing by pulsing its own light in slow-motion 4 times. Police in Utuado were simultaneously responding to multiple resident reports. Source: Sebastián Robiou, Manifiesto OVNI.

location_name: Adjuntas-Dos Bocas road, near Utuado, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Pilot filmed slow-moving, shiny silver object. Clear sky.

4:00 AM. Anonymous truck driver and assistant making a delivery, resting in truck. Driver feigned sleep and observed three whitish beings ~normal height with close-fitting helmets with a crest front-to-back, parrot-beak hooked noses, scaled outfits, peering into truck window. Beings communicated in bat-squeaking sounds. Driver developed high fever and headaches for two days after encounter, reported sensation of cranial pressure while observing beings. Investigated by Sebastián Robiou (interviewed witness January 1974). Source: Inexplicata/Scott Corrales 2012, Robiou Lamarche.

location_name: Arecibo Shopping Center warehouse, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

attributes.description: Multiple witnesses reported a green, cigar-shaped luminous object floating silently over the rainforest canopy, then vanishing.
Locals near a limestone quarry saw strange lights and found metal pit covers torn open. The mayor wrote to President Bush requesting an investigation.
